# ReShiki 0.13.1

This release improves atom-label editing, crystal substitutions, 3D model controls,
recovery and feedback on large drawings. It corrects PDF shading and browser
clipboard behavior, with clearer refusals when an export cannot preserve a drawing.

- **Atom labels:** edit beside the structure, read complete choices and accept
  chemical suggestions. Protecting-group edits retain sugar stereochemistry;
  repeated labels avoid flashing the editor.
- **Crystals and Properties:** retain substitutions, repeated cells and import
  notes. Keep whole-drawing values beside selected-fragment properties, and
  preserve the distinction between distance-derived bonds and chemical analysis.
- **3D models and drawing:** move selected models from their frame edges, keep
  captions attached when resizing, open models facing their drawings, and use
  clearer rotation, arrow and atom-mark controls.
- **Recovery and feedback:** review recovery drafts before restoring or
  discarding them, remember canvas brightness, and cancel long Structure-input
  operations.
- **Large drawings:** pointer-owned hotspots follow wheel pan and zoom, hover
  motion is smoother, and PDF copying shows progress before expensive preparation.
  [Hover review and measurement limits](https://github.com/Ameyanagi/ReShiki/blob/6183956b0bad1276f00283a84973f0b8937d341b/docs/changes/qa-pointer-hover.md).
- **Depiction:** artemisinin keeps its peroxide connector visible with the
  adjacent methyl outside the cage, and long-chain layouts separate labels.

**File compatibility:** every drawing saved by 0.13.1 uses document format 30.
ReShiki 0.13.0 and earlier cannot open these files, even when they contain no
crystal or other new feature. Older drawings still open in 0.13.1. Keep a copy
saved by an older version if you need to share with someone who still uses it.

macOS release downloads are signed and notarized. Windows and Linux downloads
remain unsigned; Windows production signing is pending.
